column1: # option_guide_prices.tsv - which canon OPTIONS item(s) each priced line of the options guide
# (option-guide/index.html, its sheet:[['line','price'],...] pairs) takes its price from.
# Stephen 2026-10-15: "Canon fills them". The canon command (gen_from_canon.pl) writes these prices
# from the workbook; verify_pricing_canon.pl fails when the page and the workbook differ.
# Columns, tab-separated:
#   guide_line     the line's text exactly as the page has it
#   canon_options  the canon OPTIONS tab's option names, exactly, separated by " || "
#   shows          how the price reads: {price} = the one canon price (stops if there are several),
#                  {min} / {max} = lowest / highest across every model and length, {both} = the
#                  "both sides = $X" figure inside the canon item's own name
# A priced line with no row here, a row whose line is gone from the page, or a canon name that no
# longer exists STOPS the canon command before it writes anything. This map is a naming job:
# never type a price into it.
